# GOTC 2026 project starter

This repository is a reusable starter, not a completed competition entry.
Create or request your own team's repository before editing project content.

Read [README.md](README.md) for the Chinese project template, setup requirements,
AI-use disclosure, sources, licensing, tests, limitations and submission checklist.

Official event website: https://etownyouthai.com/

The organization-repository request and automatic commit-selection workflow is
being integrated. Availability depends on organizer configuration and launch.
Do not treat a Git push as a formal website submission. Preserve submitted
history: do not force push or delete the official branch.

The starter documentation and ignore rules may be reused under
[TEMPLATE-LICENSE.txt](TEMPLATE-LICENSE.txt). Each team must document a license
for its own work and preserve third-party obligations.
